review: I like that each stage owns one mechanic and Gauntlet recombines all of them; that is correct teaching order. The curve is flat, not rising: First Steps kills 29 of 100 on its first spike row, which is too harsh for a tutorial, and Saw Mill (57%) is harder than Laser Gate (73%). Saw Mill deaths cluster around flying saws whose paths I cannot read from the screen. Ferry Lines and Crumble Bridge have fair pit deaths but little secondary threat. Laser Gate telegraphs its off-beams with dotted lines, which is good. Gauntlet killing the high-skill player on a laser looks like timing luck.
best: Laser Gate: dotted idle beams make every death readable and the spike-then-laser pairing escalates cleanly.
worst: Saw Mill: the hardest stage in the set sits at slot 3, with saw paths that are not telegraphed.
